steps.cap: Silicon starts as quartz rock. It is refined into rods so pure that metal impurities are no more than a few parts per billion.
The rods are melted. A seed crystal touches the melt and is drawn slowly up, turning, and the silicon freezes onto it as one long crystal.
A wire saw slices the crystal, called an ingot, into thin discs.
Each disc is ground, etched and polished to a mirror finish, flat right out to the edge.
